comparison.objective: Remove a fragile jar lid before separately moving jar and lid; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR grasps and transports separable ceramic parts. Candidate aligns a 1.5 mm bit, applies bounded torque, rotates a small collar, reacquires the moved socket, and cycles a fixture.
comparison.success_condition: PR forbids moving the jar with its lid attached and rewards safe placement on a padded tray. Candidate scores force-, travel-, rebound-, and drift-bounded repeated stops. No separate spec is available for PR.
comparison.reason: Safe fragile-object separation and transport tests a different ability from mechanical adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
